# Orders Service

Takes customer orders, checks them and stores them.

## Business rules

- An order needs at least one line.
- An order can have at most 20 lines.
- Orders under 10.00 are not accepted.
- VIP customers get a discount of 5%.
- Only placed orders can be cancelled.

## Error responses

| Status | When |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | the order is invalid |
| 404 | the order does not exist |
| 409 | the order cannot be cancelled in its state |

## Running

Run `mvn spring-boot:run` and open the service on port 8080.
The service is written in Java and keeps orders in memory.
